name: ROCKET_IDLE
meaning: on the ground, anim 3, shadow shown; the only state msg 2 offers pickup in

name: ROCKET_HELD
meaning: worn by Ralph (msg 4; msg 0x16 while attached)

name: ROCKET_CRASH
meaning: anim 4; entered from msg 5 with drop flag bit 0 (rot = (0x400, sender facing, 0)). At anim end: hidden, back to homePos, full fuel and hits, state 3

name: ROCKET_RESPAWN_WAIT
meaning: hidden for 0x3000 g_gameTime (3 s), then shown and state 4

name: ROCKET_RESPAWN_WOBBLE
meaning: rendered with ScnObject_RenderRespawnWobble for 1 s, then state 0

name: ROCKET_ACTIVATE_B
meaning: anim 2 blend; msg 0x15 arg != 0, or msg 0x10 pose 2 while active

name: ROCKET_FLYING
meaning: anim 0 loop; msg 0x10 pose 1 while active; engine sound 0x6e; hits regenerate by g_dt>>2 per frame; gauges drawn
